task_completion.description: The agent successfully launches the Nx Witness application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nx Witness desktop client interface is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The agent selects and opens the 'Lobby Camera' stream from the resource tree.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Lobby Camera' is highlighted in the left sidebar and its video feed is active in the main viewing grid.

task_completion.description: The agent interacts with the video timeline or playback controls to review the footage.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The playback scrubber is moved across the timeline, or the agent is seen pausing/playing different segments of the video.

task_completion.description: The agent opens a text editor or uses a terminal to create the report file at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) or a terminal window shows the file /home/ga/traffic_report.txt being edited.

task_completion.description: The report contains all required elements: total count estimate, traffic pattern description, and busy/quiet timestamps.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of /home/ga/traffic_report.txt is visible and includes a numerical estimate of people, a description of patterns (steady/fluctuating), and specific timestamps for peak and low traffic.

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI to analyze the video rather than just querying file metadata.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent interacting with the Nx Witness player interface (timeline, camera tree) rather than only using the command line.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final report into the file without opening the video software.
integrity.visual_evidence: There are screenshots of the video footage being displayed and reviewed before the report is finalized.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the 'Lobby Camera' specifically as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The camera name 'Lobby Camera' is clearly visible in the Nx Witness layout during the analysis phase.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Lobby Camera' uses the 'mall_pedestrian.mp4' file. This video contains approximately 2000 frames with an average of 31 people per frame (total head annotations ~62,315). The agent's estimate should reflect a high-density crowd. The report must be saved specifically to /home/ga/traffic_report.txt.
